na8417a42d0.headline: The number of 500 euro banknotes reached its lowest level since February 2002 in May
na8417a42d0.summary: The Bank of Spain reported that the number of 500 euro banknotes in circulation fell to 16.9 million in May, the lowest level since February 2002.
na8417a42d0.why: Changes in high-denomination banknote circulation can reflect shifts in cash usage, monetary policy, and anti-money laundering efforts in the Eurozone.
